## 2. New Partner-Portal Integration (v2 Specific)
*New items required for `POST /v2/data-export/request` endpoint.*

| Item | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **OAuth Scope Validation** | ✅ Pass | Spec confirms partners authenticate via OAuth scope. Compliance confirms scope validation logic is present. |
| **User Authorization Check** | ✅ Pass | Spec confirms exports are only permitted for users who have granted an active authorization to the partner. Logic verified in spec. |
| **Provenance Stamp (Audit)** | ✅ Pass | **New Requirement (2025-Q4 Bulletin).** Implementation must record: <br>1. User’s authorization grant ID<br>2. Requesting party’s identity<br>3. Authorization scope<br>4. Validity window at time of export.<br><br>*Constraint:* Entry must be written synchronously. System must fail closed if the stamp cannot be assembled. |
| **Fail-Closed Verification** | ✅ Pass | Test case confirms that if Provenance Stamp generation fails, the export request is rejected and no data is transmitted. |
